notes.title: Gardener Release coming March 7!
notes.notes:
Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers is coming out in Early Access TOMORROW, March 7th

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829011/ac54d783f61b00055abd6c00233cf184f6f3ccd8.jpg

Hello folks! I've been working hard recently to cram all reported fixes and suggested features into recent updates, and... basically forgot to announce the release. So here it is - years of passionate clicking, countless hours of debugging, and an overwhelming urge to make something different from all other simulator games on Steam, poured into this unique project. And it's just about to be released in early access, as hopefully the game is now fun enough, even if it's not feature complete yet.

I'm still not exactly sure what has grown out of it, but I think there hasn't been so far other games like it. Judge for yourself, and Watch the release trailer to know more:

[previewyoutube=UPOraFA9Nko;full][/previewyoutube]

Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers is coming out in Early Access, with hopefully many improvements, updates and features suggested by our small community. If in doubt - ask me anything on our official Discord, or on the Steam forums.

If you still haven't put the game on your Steam Wishlist, now is the best time to do it 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052790/Gardener_Master_of_Trees_and_Flowers

Cheers!
Koksny
